PrepNest is a platform where students can discover and share previous year question papers to boost their exam performance.
Got helpful question papers? Share them on PrepNest at your own price—others can purchase and access them directly.
Earn coins by referring new users, uploading papers, or purchasing any.

1. Enter the subject name for which you want to upload the Paper.

2. Provide the course name, semester. If these details match your profile, they will be fetched automatically; otherwise, you can enter them manually.

3. Select the paper type — either Semester paper or Midterm.

4. If you've selected Question Paper, choose the relevant session.

5. If the Question Paper is for a midterm exam, select the midterm type — e.g., 1st, 2nd, or 3rd.

6. Attach the files:
• For Question Papers, only image files (photos) are allowed.

Note : 
• Providing false information intentionally could result in an account ban.
• The price for your paper will be automatically set by our team
The amount can be changed by our team during verification
